A shop the neighbourhood grew up with

Venkateshwarlu General Stores has been the go-to spot for daily groceries — cooking oils, masalas, rice, snacks and household items — stocked fresh and priced fair. Walk in, and you'll usually be greeted by name.

This page exists so more of the town can find us, know what we stock, and tell others what they think.

Bulk orders for weddings, catering & hotels

We supply groceries, oils, spices and everyday essentials in bulk for weddings, catering kitchens and hotels — sourced for quality first, so what goes into the function is something you'd be happy to serve your own family. Every bulk order is quoted individually based on quantity, brands, and delivery needs.

  • Dedicated bulk quantities of oils, rice, dals, spices and masalas
  • Quality-checked stock — we don't cut corners to hit a lower price
  • Delivery coordination for event dates and hotel restocking schedules
  • A running account option for regular hotel and catering clients
